exhaust-front.summary: Three rounded-rectangular entries connect the front cylinder-head exhaust ports to curved runners and a shared cast collector.
exhaust-front.limits: The Dorman674-185 replacement application and rectangular port form are manufacturer-supported. The28×28mm mouths, corner radii, wall sections, transition length, collector shape and outlet station are provisional. A capsule-shaped collector improves the former box abstraction but is not a traced production casting. Remaining clamping hardware, pipe joint, thermal stress and flow performance are unresolved.

steps.title: Match the opening class
steps.text: Manufacturer specifications and the head-facing photograph establish rectangular rather than circular entries. Separate surrounding pads remain material around the openings, not decorative covers on top of round holes.

steps.title: Keep the head transition open
steps.text: The head entry changes with the manifold mouth. The provisional rectangular opening transitions into the existing round internal head passage; it does not certify a production head-port profile.

steps.title: Merge the three runners
steps.text: Continuous internal passages join the shared collector and retained outlet. Connected-volume and obstruction checks establish geometric openness, not exhaust pulse behavior or backpressure.

steps.title: Retain the mounting study
steps.text: The separate lifting eye and its stud/bolt remain attached to provisional casting pads. The other fourteen attachment stations and shared intake/exhaust clamping details remain unfinished.

troubleshooting.title: Distinguish CAD openness from leak integrity
troubleshooting.text: An unobstructed modeled passage does not establish a flat flange, correct clamp load, leak-free joint or safe exhaust installation. No production repair specification is inferred from the rendering.
